title: docs(pm-dispatch): name the repository each cited instrument answers for
body:
Fixes #18454
Clause-②: no

`skip-changeset` — text under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only; nothing published moves. Governed `.claude/**`: draft, four-piece, the maintainer's approval lands it. PR #18656 (SKILL.md :91) is ahead in the SKILL.md serial queue; :89–:92 are untouched here.

## What changed — one rule, three citations rewritten in place, one tell added

The card's own correction stands: this is a SKILL-text gap, not a tooling defect. No script changed. Each citation of a repo-scoped instrument now says which repository the instrument answers for, in the spelling that makes the answer checkable.

| site | before (bytes) | after (bytes) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` :201 | `- 落点不明留分诊首触,⛔ 不猜。` (44) | deleted — restated verbatim at `references/lanes/ui.md:15` and by 〈域车道〉 :242 「说不出修复碰哪个文件就还不可标」 |
| `SKILL.md` :206 (new, 〈多仓协调〉, directly under the `scripts/pm/**` 住 objectstack line) | — | `- 工装只答被告知的仓,缺 `--repo`/`PM_SWEEP_REPO` 即答 objectstack;⛔ 不答手上那张卡的仓。` (112) |
| `SKILL.md` :539 〈派发〉 | `- 门禁清单取 `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` 逐条跑,退出码先落盘,`--ran` 对账;⛔ 不抓人读输出。` (119) | `- 门禁清单取 `dispatch-gates --commands --repo 仓` 逐条跑,退出码先落盘,`--ran` 对账;被拒即手推。` (119) |
| `SKILL.md` :628 〈复核〉 | `- 入队资格 = 每个 check 为 success 或预期 skip(名单:check-expected-skips.mjs),⛔ 不是 required 子集。` (119) | `- 入队资格:每 check 绿或预期 skip,⛔ 非必查子集;名单 check-expected-skips.mjs 只判 objectstack。` (116) |
| `SKILL.md` :645 〈入队与落地〉 | `- `Clause-②: yes` 认领同笔卡上挂标;PR 开出读 `check-clause2-carriers --pair PR-NUMBER` 为 0 再请审。` (118) | `- `Clause-②: yes` 认领同笔卡上挂标;开 PR `PM_SWEEP_REPO=仓 check-clause2-carriers --pair N` 0 才请审。` (118) |
| `references/contract-review.md` :41 | `- ② 双载体已清,逐对机读 `node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair PR-NUMBER`。` (99) | `- ② 双载体已清,逐对机读 `PM_SWEEP_REPO=仓 node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair N`。` (109) |
| `references/platform-readings.md` :212 | `- 读 `total_count` 得 None、打印成 total: None,与真空集只差一个字符,而请求根本没跑。` (108) | `- 读 `total_count` 得 None、打印成 total: None,与空集只差一字符;缺键即拒绝,判别式是状态码。` (118) |

Fragments dropped to pay the byte cap, disclosed: :539 loses 「⛔ 不抓人读输出」 — the machine modes the line names (`--commands`, `--ran`) are that prohibition's mechanism, and the harvest-by-eye history lives in the script header; :628 spells 「⛔ 非必查子集」 as `core-rules.md` :124 already does and spells success as 绿 (the same twin's word) so the literal `check-expected-skips.mjs` that the gate's self-test pins stays on the line; :645 compresses 「PR 开出读 … 为 0 再请审」 to 「开 PR … 0 才请审」; :212 trades 「而请求根本没跑」 for the tell. Every line ≤ 120 B; every touched file line-neutral.

## Measured behaviour — from an objectstack checkout, 2026-09-17 12:55–13:05Z, tree `d6137fd6c` (re-derived at `4bbddc5a9`)

| instrument | told the repo by | run about `objectstack-ai/objectui` from this checkout | tell on the output |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` / `--tier` | `--repo OWNER/NAME` asserts the checkout | **REFUSES**, exit 2: `REFUSING — asked for 'objectstack-ai/objectui', but this checkout is 'objectstack-ai/objectstack'`, and names the remedy (hand-derive from the sibling's own manifest and workflows). Without `--repo`: exit 0, 18 objectstack commands on stdout, the provenance banner on **stderr only** — a `--commands > gates.list` harvest is a well-formed list about the wrong repo | the refusal; or the stderr banner `gate list derived from the tree of 'objectstack-ai/objectstack'` |
| `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr N` | `PM_SWEEP_REPO` retargets the **board only**; the roster is always this checkout's workflows (cannot be told) | **ANSWERS**, exit 4 on objectui PR #9604: `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard …)`, `dependabot` reported as 3 skips outside the roster — a verdict against the wrong roster (here a false red; a shared job name would make it a false green). Without the env: default board objectstack, PR #9604 → HTTP 404 → exit 3 NOT MEASURED | first line `board: objectstack-ai/objectui (PM_SWEEP_REPO); roster: this checkout's workflows.` — board ≠ checkout ⇒ verdict void |
| `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair N` | `PM_SWEEP_REPO` (reads no tree file) | **WORKS**: `every row below is read from objectstack-ai/objectui (source: PM_SWEEP_REPO)`; #9604 is closed so the pair is not formed (exit 2, explicitly not a clearance). Without the env: `(source: default — set PM_SWEEP_REPO to target another repo)` | the provenance line names board and source |
| container proxy, `GET /search/issues?q=repo:objectstack-ai/objectui+is:issue+kanban` | not tellable — session-bound | **refusal in a success-looking body**: HTTP **403**; body is valid JSON with keys `message`, `documentation_url` and **no** `total_count`; a `.get('total_count')` read prints None/0. Repo-scoped control `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?per_page=1` → 200, one row | the status is 403 (never 200); the key is **absent**, not zero; `documentation_url` points at docs.anthropic.com (the 415 discriminator at platform-readings :118 generalises) |

One rule reaches all four: an instrument answers for the repository it is told (`--repo`, `PM_SWEEP_REPO`), defaults to objectstack, and never for the card in your hand; a citation without the repo argument is a clearance for objectstack only. Written once at :206; each citation carries its own half.

### Triage's ask — which repo do the round-open step-1/2 readings answer when the seat works objectui from an objectstack checkout

- Step 1, `git-history.mjs touch --path=.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md --ref=origin/main`: from the objectstack worktree → `7f4aa9e5c`, proven, exit 0. From cwd `/home/user/objectui` → exit 1, `no commit on 'origin/main' touches .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (the tool also auto-deepened that clone to `--deepen=4096`; object store only, no tree edit). It answers for the cwd's repo; the charter exists only in objectstack, so run from objectstack it answers the one repo that has it, and a sibling cwd answers not-found, never a wrong sha.
- Step 2, `check-harness-current.mjs`: default `--shared` is the cwd's git common dir → `CURRENT -- every harness-loaded path on origin/main is in /home/user/objectstack HEAD d6137fd6c2`, exit 0; with `--shared /home/user/objectui` → UNDECIDED, exit 2 (graft boundary at the time). It answers for the checkout it is pointed at and names it in the verdict line.
- No SKILL line added: both readings are self-labelling (the verdict names the checkout; the charter path has one home), and the lines that own them (:89–:92) are the serial-queue block of PR #18656.

## Four-axis reasons for the placement

- **实际业务需求** — measured, not recalled: the one instrument that ANSWERS a sibling board is `check-expected-skips` (exit 4 against a foreign roster), and `--commands` without `--repo` prints a well-formed list at exit 0 with the banner on stderr. Both failures are read AT the citation, so the repair sits at :539 / :628 / :645 / contract-review :41; the principle sits once in 〈多仓协调〉 beside the line that says the toolchain lives in objectstack.
- **项目长远合理性** — no script change (the card's own correction); the citation becomes the checkable spelling, contract-first: the argument is the contract, the provenance line is the receipt.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — SKILL.md :168's order: delete the error-permitting construct, make the correct form the only spelling, only then add a check. The argument-less spellings were the construct; the cited spellings now carry `--repo 仓` / `PM_SWEEP_REPO=仓`, the non-retargetable one says 只判 objectstack, and the proxy row says 缺键即拒绝 — an absent key can no longer be read as a zero.
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — no per-repo rosters, no new gate, no ceiling raise; line-neutral, paid by deleting one line restated twice elsewhere.

Run explicitly: the derivation does not name it for a SKILL.md change, and `--ran` files it as 'Outside this card's derivation (1)' — filed as #18673.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0 — `SKILL.md` 812 lines (ceiling 812; headroom 0), widest table row 342 (pin 342); `contract-review.md` 60/60; `platform-readings.md` 466/466. `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` exit 0 (one coherent copy; 74 markdown files scanned). `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0 (27 files clean). `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
- Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from the worktree (no hand-fed paths): 19 commands, each captured redirect-then-`$?`: Re-run on `4bbddc5a9`: 19/19 exit 0 (doc-formula-expressions after the same prerequisite build through the lock, waited 0s).
  `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` 0 · `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test` 0 · `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` 0 · `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` 0 · `check-harness-current.mjs --self-test` 0 · `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` 0 (first run exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET — unbuilt `@objectstack/formula`/`@objectstack/lint`; built through `os-verify-lock.sh` after one queue-timeout (exit 99, holder: a sibling's `check:pm-dispatch-gates`), then 0) · `check:agent-test-spelling` 0 · `check:doc-authoring` 0 · `check:driver-memory-census` 0 · `check:nul-bytes` 0 · `check:pm-governed-merges` 0 · `check:pm-governed-prose` 0 · `check:pm-half-states` 0 · `check:pm-skill-id-lint` 0 · `check:pm-skill-ratchet` 0 · `check:refd-timer-probe` 0 · `check:required-contexts` 0 · `check:skill-frame-sync` 0 · `check:watch-hint-literal` 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 19 derived, 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the three paths: exit 3 GOVERNED, as expected.
- Tier: `--tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the touched files → MANDATORY, clause ① from `SKILL.md`.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: `git-history.mjs touch` run from a sibling cwd fetches `--deepen` up to 4096 into that clone before answering not-found — an operator-visible side effect on a checkout the tool does not own (its header says deepening is an operator action). Carrier: none; recorded here for the skills seat.
- noted, not filed: `true-green.md` :15–:16 and `platform-readings.md` :392 already state the `dispatch-gates.mjs` cross-repo behaviour for the dev side; this PR adds the PM-side citation and the rule, and leaves those readings in place.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能文本在四处引用住在 objectstack 的工装(门禁派生 `dispatch-gates`、预期 skip 名单 `check-expected-skips`、条款②配对检查 `check-clause2-carriers`)时,现在每处都写明它答的是哪个仓、拼写里带上仓参数;〈多仓协调〉加一条总则「工装只答被告知的仓,缺参数即答 objectstack,⛔ 不答手上那张卡的仓」;平台读数表里代理拒绝那一行补上判别式(缺键即拒绝,看状态码)。零脚本改动,三个文件行数全部中性。

**为什么改**:一位在 objectui 上工作的席位实测:三件工装三种行为,其中预期 skip 名单会拿 objectstack 的花名册去判 objectui 的板,交出一份它判不了的放行;技能文本里没有任何一行提醒。本 PR 逐件复测并把结论写在被引用的那一行上。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本改动。付账方式是删掉 SKILL.md 一行在 `lanes/ui.md` 与〈域车道〉均已重述的规则;:539 为容纳 `--repo` 去掉了「⛔ 不抓人读输出」的措辞(机读模式已由 `--commands`/`--ran` 拼写承载)。回滚 = revert 单个 commit。

**席位意见**:(留给席位)
